overall.headline: Global EFB and Flight Planning Selections Show Diverse Adoption Across Carrier Models
observations: Across **519** total airlines, **127** recorded EFB selections led by **AvioBook** at **21** of **127** (**16.5%**) and **In-house built** solutions at **19** of **127** (**15.0%**).
For flight planning, **68** airlines recorded selections, with **Lido** leading at **24** of **68** (**35.3%**) followed by **NavBlue** at **16** of **68** (**23.5%**).
Flag carriers and LCCs display varied system preferences depending on fleet size bands, though missing values prevent universal baseline assumptions.
overall.caveat: Counts represent recorded selections rather than absolute market share, and missing fields reflect unknown data rather than non-adoption.

regions.name: Europe & Central Asia
regions.headline: European Carriers Rely Heavily on In-House and AvioBook Solutions
observations: Out of **151** airlines, **35** recorded EFB selections, where **In-house built** reached **7** of **35** (**20.0%**) and **AvioBook** reached **6** of **35** (**17.1%**).
For flight planning, **14** airlines recorded selections, with **Lido** at **5** of **14** (**35.7%**) and **FlightKeys** at **4** of **14** (**28.6%**).
**0** of **14** planning-recorded European airlines list **Sabre**, diverging from broader global patterns.
regions.caveat: Counts are recorded selections from Airtable and do not cover all regional carriers.

regions.name: East Asia & Pacific
regions.headline: Significant Adoption of In-House EFB and NavBlue Planning in East Asia
observations: Among **130** airlines, **39** recorded EFB selections, featuring **In-house built** at **9** of **39** (**23.1%**) and **Paper** at **6** of **39** (**15.4%**).
For flight planning, **18** airlines recorded selections, led by **NavBlue** at **9** of **18** (**50.0%**) and **Lido** at **7** of **18** (**38.9%**).
**NavBlue** planning usage here exceeds the overall global rate relative to recorded planning entries.
regions.caveat: Unrecorded fields are treated as unknown rather than indicating zero usage.

regions.name: North America
regions.headline: North American Carriers Favor AvioBook EFB and FlightKeys Planning
observations: From **59** airlines, **14** recorded EFB selections, with **AvioBook** leading at **5** of **14** (**35.7%**).
For flight planning, **9** airlines recorded selections, where **FlightKeys** dominates at **5** of **9** (**55.6%**).
**0** of **9** planning-recorded North American airlines list **Lido**, contrasting sharply with the global preference.
regions.caveat: Multi-select fields and partial data reporting limit definitive market share conclusions.

regions.name: Latin America & Caribbean
regions.headline: Balanced Regional Distribution Across Multiple EFB and Planning Vendors
observations: Out of **56** airlines, **12** recorded EFB selections, showing a split including **AvioBook**, **Flightman**, and **Paper** each at **2** of **12** (**16.7%**).
For flight planning, **9** airlines recorded selections, led by **Lido** at **4** of **9** (**44.4%**).
**0** of **9** planning-recorded carriers in this region list **NavBlue**.
regions.caveat: Aggregate counts reflect explicit database entries and should not imply total market penetration.

regions.name: Middle East & North Africa
regions.headline: MENA Region Displays High Reliance on Bytron Skybook and Jeppesen
observations: Among **51** airlines, **15** recorded EFB selections, led by **Bytron Skybook**, **Jeppesen Aviator**, and **Paper** each at **3** of **15** (**20.0%**).
For flight planning, **10** airlines recorded selections, with **Lido** and **NavBlue** tied at **3** of **10** (**30.0%**) each.
**Jeppesen Aviator** EFB adoption here outpaces its overall global proportional representation.
regions.caveat: Missing data points mean unlisted vendors cannot be assumed absent from actual operations.

regions.name: Sub-Saharan Africa
regions.headline: Sub-Saharan African Carriers Show Fragmented EFB and Planning Choices
observations: From **47** airlines, **8** recorded EFB selections, with **IFS EFBOne** leading at **2** of **8** (**25.0%**).
For flight planning, **4** airlines recorded selections, where **Lido** accounts for **2** of **4** (**50.0%**).
**0** of **8** EFB-recorded carriers in this region list **In-house built** solutions.
regions.caveat: Small sample sizes for recorded fields require cautious interpretation of percentages.

regions.name: South Asia
regions.headline: South Asian Market Records Minimal System Adoption Across Segments
observations: Out of **13** airlines, **4** recorded EFB selections across various vendors including **AvioBook**, **In-house built**, **Navblue Mission+**, and **Paper** at **1** of **4** (**25.0%**) each.
For flight planning, **4** airlines recorded selections, with **Lido** at **2** of **4** (**50.0%**).
**0** of **4** EFB-recorded carriers list **Bytron Skybook**.
regions.caveat: Low recording rates restrict broad regional generalizability.
